title: Munin model routing configuration
description: Validates the Metis four-catalog model routing topology (configs/models.json): providers, models, budgets and routes. The root object and every catalog entry are closed (additionalProperties: false); provider, model and budget catalog entry names are arbitrary; all eight required routes must be present; schema_version must be exactly 1. No provider/model defaults or credentials are defined here.

schema_version.description: The models.json schema version. Only 1 is accepted.

providers.description: Catalog of provider implementations. Keys are arbitrary provider ids; each entry names the adapter, base_url and api_key_env. Provider ids are distinct from the runtime adapter string.

^.+$.description: One provider definition. api_key_env is the environment variable NAME; credentials are never inlined here.

models.description: Catalog of model definitions. Keys are arbitrary model names; values reference a provider and carry the vendor model_id plus capabilities.

^.+$.description: One model definition. provider references a key of the providers catalog.

budgets.description: Catalog of execution budgets. Keys are arbitrary budget names; values cap model and tool calls.

routes.description: Catalog of model routes. All eight required route entries must be present; each references a model and a budget.

route.description: One model route. model references a model name, budget references a budget name; fallbacks reference other route names.
